subject: Renewal: Seat-to-Consumption conversion + co-term path
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@novaplay.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodai.com
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@novaplay.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Question: mid-contract switch from seats to consumption (renewal pending)

Hi Jasmine —

Quick question as we start planning our renewal: our product team expects a burst of inference usage next quarter and we'd prefer to move from a seat-based license to a usage model (tokens/minutes) mid-contract if possible.

Key asks:
- Can Redwood convert a portion of our annual seat commitment to a usage bucket without restarting the term?
- What uplift or discount bands would you recommend for a 6–12 month consumption overlay?
- Can we co-term the consumption overlay with our upcoming renewal (Nov 12)?

We can share a short usage forecast (attached). Looking for ballpark economics first so we can present to procurement.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Platform — Novaplay

Attachment: usage_estimate_q3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 47KB)

From: jasmine.liu@redwoodai.com <jasmine.liu@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@novaplay.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@novaplay.com>, ben.carter@redwoodai.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question: mid-contract switch from seats to consumption (renewal pending)

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the forecast, that helps. Short answer: yes, we can support a hybrid overlay (convert X seats into reserved consumption units + keep Y seats) and co-term the overlay into your Nov 12 renewal.

Two pragmatic options I recommend for internal review:

1) Short-term overlay (6 months) — Standard consumption rate + 5% uplift on token price; no long-term commit. Good for burst protection.

2) Committed consumption (12 months, co-term) — 10% discount off list consumption rate in exchange for an annualized usage commit; we can partially annualize the converted seat dollars to hit your renewal target.

Operational notes:
- We'll create an amendment that lists the converted seats, maps them to a consumption bucket, and pro-rates any unused seat dollars to the new bucket.
- We can include a one-time bridging credit to soften mid-term price movement (suggestion: $25k voucher).

Ben, looping you in for pricing guardrails — moving to you for guidance on discount caps and whether we should ask for a minimum monthly usage floor.

Next step: if either option looks acceptable I can draft the co-term amendment and DocuSign packet.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter@redwoodai.com <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodai.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question: mid-contract switch from seats to consumption (renewal pending)

Thanks for the context. My guidance:
- For a customer of Novaplay's size and predictable spike, 10% off list for a 12-month committed overlay is reasonable if we get a signed consumption minimum that approximates 65–70% of your forecast.
- Keep the 6-month overlay option as a fallback but attach a slightly higher uplift (7.5%) and no bridging credit.
- Approve a $20k bridging credit (slightly below suggested) as a one-time concession to keep procurement moving.

Marcus, can you confirm whether Finance needs a different wording for pro-rata conversion of seat dollars to consumption units (we should avoid creating invoicing reconciliation headaches).

-Ben
VP, Sales Operations

From: marcus.lin@redwoodai.com <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
To: ben.carter@redwoodai.com, jasmine.liu@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 08:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question: mid-contract switch from seats to consumption (renewal pending)

All —
Finance is fine with the pro-rata approach as long as the amendment includes:
- Clear mapping of seat dollar value -> consumption units (rate table included).
- A reconciliation window (30 days after the overlay starts) where usage that exceeds forecast is credited toward future invoicing, and under-use is refunded as a credit against renewal if outside the agreed monthly floor.

I'll draft a short bill-of-math section for legal/finance to include in the amendment. Agree with Ben on the $20k bridging credit.

-Marcus
Director, Commercial Ops

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@novaplay.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodai.com
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@novaplay.com>, ben.carter@redwoodai.com, marcus.lin@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question: mid-contract switch from seats to consumption (renewal pending)

Hi all —

Thanks, that all sounds workable. Novaplay prefers Option 2 (12-month committed consumption, co-term) with the following asks to finalize:
- Confirm the 10% discount and the 65% minimum monthly usage floor.
- Include the $20k bridging credit in the amendment.
- Please send the amendment + SOW + DocuSign link so our procurement team can review.

If we can get the packet today we can escalate internally and aim to sign by end of week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Alex
Head of Platform — Novaplay
